dataset_title: 2021 Census DataPacks for Victoria and Greater Melbourne (SA1/SA2/LGA)

admission_evidence.native_record_key: Census vintage + ASGS scheme + region code + metric
admission_evidence.completeness_rule: ABS Census DataPack table headers match metadata definitions; suppressed/missing values preserved without zero-filling

invariants.suppressed_and_missing_rule: Confidentiality-suppressed values ('..', '-', 'np', 'suppressed') and missing values maintain status = 'suppressed' | 'missing' and null values; they must NEVER be zero-filled.
invariants.vintage_rule: 2021 Census DataPacks are paired with 2021 ASGS boundary vintage (ASGS_SA1, ASGS_SA2, ASGS_LGA);跨年份边界不静默混用。
invariants.status_rule: ABS DataPacks are CC BY 4.0; published source facts retain verified_open rights and suppressed cells remain null.
